anti_patterns.description: Skill references use correct paths but could benefit from filename-only pattern for consistency

optimization_suggestions.recommended_replacement:
Reference skill files with minimal context:

## Four Hats Methodology

Apply all four perspectives sequentially. See skill files for detailed checklists:

| Hat | Skill Reference | Focus |
|-----|-----------------|-------|
| Graph Theorist | `edge-reliability/SKILL.md` | Edge boundaries |
| Lawyer | `node-reliability/SKILL.md` | Node contracts |
| Operator | `operational-reliability/SKILL.md` | Observability |
| Historian | `operational-reliability/SKILL.md` | Maintainability |
optimization_suggestions.rationale: Skill files contain the full checklists. Agent only needs to reference them, not duplicate.

optimization_suggestions.recommended_replacement:
**Severity Classification**: See `code-review-standards/reference/severity-classification.md`

Quick reference: CRITICAL (runtime failure) | HIGH (silent failure) | MEDIUM (suboptimal) | LOW (maintainability)
optimization_suggestions.rationale: Severity definitions are shared across review agents. Single source reduces drift.

optimization_suggestions.recommended_replacement:
## Workflow Phases

| Phase | Actions |
|-------|--------|
| OBSERVE | Parse input, read both files, identify boundary |
| ORIENT | Apply four hats via skill checklists, record evidence |
| DECIDE | Aggregate findings, sort by severity, dedupe |
| ACT | Format tables, generate summary, return output |
optimization_suggestions.rationale: Compress verbose list format into table. OODA pattern is well-established.
